steps: With a designated local Lark relay fixture, admit one event and observe its AM response and platform reply.
expected_result: The configured relay routes an admitted event and reply with its exact trust mode; unavailable modes stay unavailable.
cross_replica_assertion: Repeat N>=3 through the sole caller lane and retain request/event/report/bot IDs plus serving EG, serving AM and owning AM attribution where that step uses them. Show observations on both AMs for AM-backed features; N>=3 alone does not prove distribution. Mark non-AM browser/EG-only steps AM-not-applicable. Preserve retries, duplicate/unknown outcomes, record-revision conflicts and provision 500s per feature; no direct-AM substitution for a platform bot journey.
